description: Aquí damos prototipos beneficiosos para los tripulantes (astronautas) o herramientas ya que nosotros nos enfocamos en utilizar la tecnología,la ciencia y la astronomía.
summary: I will now provide a summary of my project, called T.S.B.A.T. (Technological Space-Based Astronomical Tool). This project is quite interesting, as I have developed a prototype designed to measure the temperatures of space objects—such as lunar or Martian rocks—which is intended to be worn on the left arm, near the wrist. Please note that the project is not yet 100% complete; for now, I am submitting a progress demonstration that includes technical drawings and slides.
details:
This project is designed to measure the temperatures of space objects, such as lunar and Martian rocks. It utilizes a prototype that I have built based on technical drawings—though it should be noted that the project is not yet 100% complete. The materials used for my prototype are as follows:-Metal for the structure

.Arduino Uno

-solar panel

-SH1106 OLED display

-Infrared temperature sensor:MLX906H

-Microswitch bottons 2 pines

-Radiators

-adjustable tactical strap for use over the EMU suit

The hardware and software I used include an Arduino Uno, along with the C and C++ programming languages. The purpose of this project is to benefit astronauts by allowing them to measure the temperatures of objects in space and transmit that data back to Earth via a satellite—though I have not yet been able to fully complete that part of the project.
